description: REGRESSION: real Chrome+uBlock dashboard session was classified 'Mastodon Family' (see https://staging.stylobot.net/dashboard/signature/Cd3rCikNaSaLLLG0rXMv8Q exported 2026-06-03). Root cause: the umbrella mastodon archetype (minimal-headers, Accept=*/*, no Sec-Fetch, no Upgrade-Insecure-Requests) wins the unweighted cosine pick against chrome-desktop for any Chrome-issued XHR / SignalR /negotiate / API-fetch because XHRs by spec don't carry Upgrade-Insecure-Requests and only set 3 of 4 Sec-Fetch headers (Dest, Mode, Site -- no Sec-Fetch-User), and uBlock Origin strips Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile. Mastodon's centroid is broad enough to absorb the resulting shape. This scenario reproduces it with the user's real UA and the request mix that triggered the misclassification in production.
